## About
Transamerica Auto-Repair Specialists is an engine, transmission and body shop on N Nebraska Ave in Tampa. We handle everyday maintenance like A/C, brakes and alignment, and the complex mechanical work too: engine overhauls, machining, fabrication and welding, all in house.
Your vehicle is worked on by ASE certified technicians, and our Master Technicians give every finished job a second look. We use modern computer and software readers to pin point factory codes, so we treat what your car actually needs.
Customers know the crew by name. One reviewer had Orlando head the body work while John took the lead on the brakes, and said Jack has taught his crew right.

## Services
- A/C System Check & Repair: We check your A/C system, find out why it isn't working properly, and make the repairs so you ride comfortably.
- Engine Cooling Systems Check & Flush: Your cooling and heating system should be in top working order all year. We flush it and get it pH balanced.
- Brake Repair and Replacement: Full service brakes: system components, traction controls, lines, power boosters, drums and shoes, ABS. We replace pads and discs and machine rotors in house.
- Suspension & Alignment Repair: Suspension wears out slowly. Our alignment and suspension tools let us advise you on what you really need and what to skip.
- Check Engine & Indicator Lights: We use modern computer and software readers to pin point the factory codes behind a glowing or flashing CHECK ENGINE light.
- Complete Engine Overhauling: We remanufacture foreign and domestic engines in house, from high performance street engines to stock builds with factory specs.
- Machining Services: Our own machine shop with a fabrication and welding team: cylinder boring and honing, head resurfacing, valve jobs, crankshaft straightening and Magna-fluxing to detect cracks.
- Auto Body Repair: Collision and body work alongside the mechanical side. One customer brought their daughter's car in after a fender bender and shared before and after photos.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Can my business set up an account?
A: Yes. We offer business accounts for fleets. Call or email us to find out what you need to know about working with us as a business.

Q: Do you work on custom setups?
A: We help diagnose and adjust customizations, from lowered suspension systems to aftermarket HID lighting, with flat rate consultation and adjustment services.

Q: Will you explain what my car needs?
A: That's the goal. One reviewer said we let you know all the details and explain what work needs to be done and why.
